company.name: Lunchbox Technologies
company.shortDescription: Lunchbox Technologies is the premier online ordering system for enterprise restaurant chains to grow their online presence.
company.description:
Lunchbox Technologies develops an online ordering engine for restaurants. It offers various features such as app ordering, web ordering, kiosk, and others that enable restaurants to create customizable digital ordering experiences that keep them fully engaged with their brand.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York.
